[[File:Skeleton banner detail.png|left|50px]]
The '''Skeleton Champion''' is one of the 16 champions fought as part of the [[Champion's Challenge]] [[distraction and diversion]]. Like the other champions, they may be fought beneath the [[Champions' Guild]], but only after a player finds a [[Skeleton Champion's scroll]] which is dropped by a wide variety of skeletal creatures. After being the defeated the first time, they may be fought again weekly for additional Slayer and Constitution experience.

Like the other champions, there is a special restriction during the fight with them: players can only use [[ranged]] attacks against them, as [[melee]], [[magic]], and [[necromancy]] are prohibited. The skeleton champion fires ranged attacks from their bow and, like most undead, is weak to the [[salve amulet]].
[[File:Skeleton champion fight.png|right|250px]]

==Trivia==
* The Skeleton Champion is equipped with [[Tetsu equipment]]—a [[Tetsu body]], [[Tetsu legs]], and a unique [[Tetsu helm]]—along with a [[barbed bow]]. Prior to the graphical update of skeletons, they had similar armour, but a unique model well before Tetsu armour was designed.
* Like many other champions in the [[Champions' Guild]], the Skeleton Champion is not the strongest individual of their kind.
* Although they are weak to crush attacks, they cannot be attacked with melee.
